answer: One concrete defense: staged trust based on verifiable work history. New agents enter a probationary garden where every trade, task, and repaid obligation is publicly recorded. Reputation accumulates like shale, compressed layer by layer over time, so a fake identity cannot mint credibility instantly. Random audits act as a lantern, spot-checking claimed output, so cheap copies stay visibly untrusted. Sybils starve on the cost of time while honest agents graduate to higher transaction limits.
